exercises.name: WALL-SUPPORTED HIP / GLUTE ACTIVATION
howTo: Stand facing a wall and place your hips high against the wall.
Keep your heels up off the ground.
Keep your knees pretty well extended (soft, not locked).
Turn your knees and toes slightly inward.
Bend forward from the hips (let your torso hang).
focus: Bend forward and relax the upper body

other.Subtitle: ACTIVATE THE GLUTES. SET THE FOUNDATION.
Purpose: Activates the glutes and posterior chain
Prepares the body for Weeks 0-6 of the Hip and Lower Back Protocols

exercises.proTip: If this causes increased radiating, burning or tingling pain (nerve-like symptoms), reduce to 1-2 repetitions initially and build tolerance gradually.

exercises.name: PELVIC FLOOR ACTIVATION
howTo: After you urinate, gently contract the muscles to hold urine (bladder Kegel), then relax. Do 5-10 repetitions.
Then contract the muscles to hold fecal matter (anal Kegel), then relax. Do 5-10 repetitions.
Perform both exercises every time after you urinate.
focus: Do not repeatedly start and stop your urine stream.
Use the sensation of stopping/expelling as a guide, and perform the repetitions after urination.
Keep the contractions gentle and controlled.

other.Subtitle: BLADDER & ANAL KEGEL EXERCISES
Benefits: Improves pelvic floor strength and coordination
Supports core and lower back stability
May reduce urgency and incontinence symptoms
Creates a strong foundation for all future hip and lower back work

steps: BLADDER (URINARY) KEGEL: Same motion you would use to stop urine flow.
ANAL (BOWEL) KEGEL: Same motion you would use to hold fecal matter.

weeks.label: Week 0
weeks.notes:
Goal: Reduce pain, restore stability, and build confidence.

Stay in Week 0 as long as needed. Move forward only when you have NO PAIN AT REST.

DO THESE EVERY DAY:
- PILLOW BELT / SI BELT - Wear during all upright activities as needed.
- SHOULDERS DOWN - Keep shoulders down and relaxed. Avoid shrugging.
- 10-20% GLUTE ENGAGEMENT - Lightly squeeze glutes throughout the day.
- 10-20% CORE ENGAGEMENT - Brace your core gently, like preparing for a light punch.
- NEUTRAL PELVIS - Avoid arching low back. Ribs down, pelvis level.
- WALKING - 15-20 minutes comfortable pace daily.

STABILITY BASICS – PAIN RELIEF & CONTROL
Perform these movements 1-2 times per day.

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Stay in Week 0 as long as it takes to have NO PAIN AT REST.
- It's normal to feel mild muscle work. Sharp pain, joint pain, numbness, tingling, or radiating pain are NOT normal.
- Quality over quantity. Stop if symptoms increase.
- Consistency is the key. Small daily habits create big changes.

THE GOAL:
Reduce pain, calm the nervous system, and rebuild trust in your body. When you are pain-free at rest and these movements feel easy and comfortable, you are ready for Week 1.

PAIN GUIDE:
- GOOD 0-3/10 - Mild muscle effort, soreness, or tightness. This is acceptable.
- CAUTION 4-6/10 - Reduce range or intensity. Focus on quality and breathing.
- STOP 7-10/10 - Sharp pain, joint pain, numbness, tingling, or radiating pain. Stop and reassess.

MD FIT RULES:
- Protect your spine.
- Hips move; spine stays quiet.
- Glutes initiate lower body movement.
- Shoulders stay down and relaxed.
- Stop if symptoms travel farther down the leg.
- Progress only when you are pain-free at rest.

weeks.label: Week 10
weeks.focus: BUILD STRENGTH AND FUNCTION: POWER, CONTROL & PERFORMANCE
weeks.notes:
Goal: Maximize lower-body strength, stability, and full-body control with advanced movement patterns.

MAIN CIRCUIT – COMPLETE AS MANY ROUNDS AS POSSIBLE IN UNDER 30 MINUTES

HOW IT WORKS:
- 10 REPS OF EACH MOVEMENT + 4 x 20 FT MOVING BEAR CRAWLS = 1 ROUND
- COMPLETE 1-2 ROUNDS (KEEP TOTAL TIME UNDER 30 MINUTES)

THE GOAL:
Build up to 5 total rounds in under 30 minutes with perfect form and no assistance.

FINISHER (NOT TIMED) – GHD SIT-UP

REMEMBER:
10 REPS OF EACH MOVEMENT + 4 x 20 FT MOVING BEAR CRAWLS = 1 ROUND. Complete 1-2 rounds in under 30 minutes. Quality always comes before quantity.

GOAL:
Build up to 5 total rounds in under 30 minutes with perfect form and no assistance.

weeks.label: Weeks 11-12
weeks.focus: BUILD STRENGTH AND FUNCTION: POWER, CONTROL & PERFORMANCE
weeks.notes:
Goal: Maximize lower-body strength, stability, and full-body control with advanced movement patterns.

MAIN CIRCUIT – COMPLETE AS MANY ROUNDS AS POSSIBLE IN UNDER 30 MINUTES
- EACH MOVEMENT = 10 REPS
- MOVING BEAR CRAWL = 4 × 20 FT (FORWARD AND BACK = 1 REP)
- 1 ROUND = ALL 6 MOVEMENTS COMPLETED
PERFORM WITH PERFECT FORM.

As you approach the 30-minute mark, reduce assistance (TRX angle, support, or weight) to make the rounds harder while maintaining perfect form.

PROGRESS AND INTENSITY:
Progress by increasing rounds week to week. At the 30-minute mark, remove assistance to make the rounds harder while maintaining perfect form.
- 1-2 ROUNDS - WEEKS 11
- 2-3 ROUNDS - WEEKS 12
- 3-4 ROUNDS - WEEKS 13+
- 5 ROUNDS - GOAL

GOAL:
Perform 5 full rounds in under 30 minutes without assistance on any movement. Continue progressing beyond Week 12 until you can complete 5 total rounds in under 30 minutes without assistance on any movement, with perfect form.

FINISHER (NOT TIMED) – GHD SIT-UP PROGRESSION

sourceNotes: Read all 13 PNGs (thumbnail endpoint, sz=w2400): foundation 1024x1536 portrait; weeks 0-12 1536x1024 landscape. Weeks 3-8 are two-page spreads (cards 1-9 on the left, 10-17 on the right, with MD FIT RULES on both pages). Weeks 0, 1, 2, 9, 10 and 11-12 are single pages. Foundation is a different kind of page: the 'BASELINE PHASE / FOUNDATION & ACTIVATION' sheet with wall glute activation and Kegels. Week 0 is a 'calm the spine' daily-basics sheet with 6 gentle movements, a pain guide and its own short rule list. Weeks 10 and 11-12 are timed circuit sheets (6 movements x 10 reps, AMRAP under 30 min) with a GHD sit-up finisher. Every card was read from 2x crops, plus extra 2.5-5x crops for small print, and a second verification pass compared half-sheet crops against this JSON. Sheet typos are kept and listed in uncertain. En dashes in ranges are converted to ASCII hyphens; '×' is kept where printed (Weeks 11-12), and the en dash in titles like 'DEAD BUG – ARMS ONLY' is kept.
